pullRequest.title: Add template filters and retire the legacy renderer
pullRequest.body:
## Summary

Adds `|` filters to template variables and retires the deprecated `$name` renderer.

### Changes

- New `src/filters.rs` with `upper`, `lower`, `title`, `kebab`, `squash` and `truncate(n)`
- `Token::Variable` / `Node::Variable` now carry a filter chain; unknown filters fail parsing with `UnknownFilter`
- Conditions treat `"0"` as false, via a new `is_truthy` helper
- Removed `src/legacy.rs` (deprecated since 0.0.9)
- Renamed `src/format.rs` to `src/render.rs`; `fence` no longer doubles a trailing newline
- Regenerated `gen/schema.rs` (adds `default_filters`) and bumped vendored escape-lite to 1.3.0

### Example

```rust
let template = Template::parse("{{name | squash | title}}")?;
assert_eq!(template.render(&[("name", "ada   lovelace")])?, "Ada Lovelace");
```

> **Note:** callers of `legacy::render_simple` must migrate to `{{name}}` placeholders.
